objectives.textEn: Representation of natural numbers, integers, rational numbers on the number line
nth root of a real number
Rationalization of expressions of the type 1/(a+b√x) and 1/(√x+√y)
Laws of exponents with integral and rational powers
Polynomial in one variable, coefficients, degree
Algebraic identities up to degree three
Linear equations in two variables: ax + by + c = 0
Infinitely many solutions as ordered pairs (graph assessed formatively only)
Real-life ratio and proportion problems (assessed formatively only)
Introduction to Euclid's Geometry: history (Geometry in India, Euclid), definitions, axioms and postulates, five postulates, axiom vs theorem

Lines and Angles: adjacent angles on a line equal 180°, vertically opposite angles equal, parallel lines (corresponding, alternate, interior angles with transversal assessed formatively only; angle sum of triangle = 180°, exterior angle formative only)
Triangles: congruence criteria SAS, ASA, SSS, RHS; angles opposite equal sides (triangle inequalities formative only)
Quadrilaterals: diagonal divides parallelogram into congruent triangles, opposite sides and angles equal, diagonals bisect, mid-point theorem

Circles: equal chords subtend equal angles, perpendicular from centre bisects chord, equal chords equidistant, angle at centre = 2× angle at circumference, angles in same segment, cyclic quadrilateral opposite angles = 180° (definitions, one circle through 3 non-collinear points, and constructions assessed formatively only)
Surface areas and volumes of spheres (including hemispheres) and right circular cones
Cubes, cuboids, right circular cylinders (assessed formatively only)
Data collection and presentation (assessed formatively only)
Mean, median, mode of ungrouped data (assessed formatively only)
Matter in Our Surroundings: definition, particulate nature, states of matter and characteristics, change of state (melting, freezing, evaporation, condensation, sublimation)

Is Matter Around Us Pure: elements, compounds, mixtures, heterogeneous and homogeneous mixtures, colloids and suspensions, physical and chemical changes (excluding separation of mixture components), pure and impure substances
Atoms and Molecules: atoms and molecules, Law of Chemical Combination, chemical formulae of common compounds, atomic and molecular masses
Structure of Atom: sub-atomic particles (electrons, protons, neutrons), models of atom, valency, atomic number and mass number, isotopes and isobars

Cell - Basic Unit of Life: cell as basic unit, prokaryotic and eukaryotic cells, multicellular organisms, cell membrane and cell wall, organelles and inclusions (chloroplast, mitochondria, vacuoles, ER, Golgi), nucleus, chromosomes (basic structure, number)
Tissues, Organs, Organ System, Organism: structure and functions of animal and plant tissues (four types of animal tissues; meristematic and permanent plant tissues)
Health and Diseases: infectious and non-infectious diseases, microbes, prevention, Pulse Polio (included but assessed formatively only)
Motion: distance and displacement, velocity, uniform and non-uniform motion, acceleration, distance-time and velocity-time graphs, uniform circular motion (elementary)
Force and Newton's Laws: force and motion, Newton's laws, action-reaction, inertia and mass, momentum, force and acceleration (elementary idea of conservation of momentum formative only)
Gravitation: universal law, gravity, acceleration due to gravity, mass and weight, free fall
Floatation: thrust and pressure, Archimedes' Principle, buoyancy
Work, Energy and Power: work, energy, power, kinetic and potential energy, law of conservation of energy (excluding commercial unit of energy)
Sound: nature and propagation, speed of sound, range of hearing, ultrasound, reflection of sound, echo
Plant and animal breeding and selection for quality improvement
Section I - Events and Processes: Ch 1 The French Revolution; Ch 2 Socialism in Europe and the Russian Revolution; Ch 3 Nazism and the Rise of Hitler

Section II - Livelihoods, Economies and Societies: Ch 4 Forest, Society and Colonialism (interdisciplinary project, internally assessed 5 marks); Ch 5 Pastoralists in the Modern World (Periodic Assessment only)
Ch 5 Natural Vegetation and Wildlife (map pointing only in annual exam; interdisciplinary project with History Ch 4, 5 marks)
Ch 1 What is Democracy? Why Democracy?
Ch 1 The Story of Village Palampur (Periodic Assessment only)
Real Numbers: Fundamental Theorem of Arithmetic
Polynomials: zeros and relation between zeros and coefficients of quadratics
Pair of Linear Equations in Two Variables: graphical and algebraic methods (substitution, elimination), consistency
Quadratic Equations: factorization, quadratic formula, discriminant and nature of roots
Arithmetic Progressions: nth term and sum of n terms
Triangles: similarity and Basic Proportionality Theorem
Circles: tangent perpendicular to radius, equal tangents from an external point
Heights and Distances: angle of elevation and depression (angles limited to 30°/45°/60°)
Areas Related to Circles: sectors and segments with central angles 60°/90°/120°
Surface Areas and Volumes: combinations of two solids
Mean, median, mode of grouped data
Chemical Reactions and Equations: types and oxidation/reduction
Acids, Bases and Salts: pH, NaOH, bleaching powder, baking soda, washing soda, Plaster of Paris
Metals and Non-metals: reactivity series, ionic compounds, metallurgy, corrosion
Carbon and its Compounds: covalent bonds, hydrocarbons, homologous series, nomenclature, ethanol and ethanoic acid, soaps and detergents
Life Processes: nutrition, respiration, transport, excretion
Control and Coordination: nervous system, plant and animal hormones, reflex action
Reproduction: asexual and sexual, reproductive health
Human eye and defects of vision
Refraction through prism, dispersion and scattering
Electric current, Ohm's law, resistance and resistivity
Magnetic effects: field lines, solenoid, Fleming's Left Hand Rule, AC/DC, domestic circuits
Our Environment: ecosystem, ozone depletion, biodegradable and non-biodegradable waste
The Rise of Nationalism in Europe
The Making of a Global World (sub-topics 1-1.3 in Board exam; 2-4.4 via interdisciplinary project)
The Age of Industrialisation (Periodic Assessment only, not in Board exam)
Print Culture and the Modern World
Lifelines of National Economy (map pointing evaluated in Board)
Globalisation and the Indian Economy (parts in Board, parts as project)
